name: MDMA
tierNotes: Threshold: lights slightly juicier — halos a touch wider than the lens should give.
Common: starbursts on every light source + first episodic eye-wiggle bursts (spike-curve jitter — bursts, never constant).
Strong: constant fine shimmer on bright regions, strong frequent wiggle.
Heavy: doubled starbursts (late doubleVision), judder, peripheral shadow-flicker at low weight.
